I have farmed this land for over fifty years, and because I own it, I invest in keeping the soil fertile for my grandchildren. I will plant improved maize seed and apply both manure and chemical fertilizer — about 40 kg of nitrogen per hectare, which is one bag of DAP and one-and-a-half bags of urea per hectare that I get through the voucher program. I will also spray herbicide because at 71 years old I cannot bend over six hectares to pull weeds by hand, and the family needs that time for other work. My family will spend about 150 days on this plot over the season, and I will hire outside laborers for 80 days, mostly for planting and harvesting when the rains come and we must move quickly.
